summary.intent: Execute Phase 23 (rust-sdk-extraction) which extracts CipherBox's crypto, core types, API client, FUSE filesystem, and SDK orchestration into a Cargo workspace with separate crates, then review and clean up the resulting code.
summary.outcome: All 7 plans executed successfully across 4 waves, producing 5 new Rust crates (cipherbox-crypto, cipherbox-core, cipherbox-api-client, cipherbox-fuse, cipherbox-sdk). Verification found 2 gaps (orphaned FUSE files + missing Windows FUSE extraction). Post-execution code review cleaned up orphaned files, a misleading allow attribute, and a double HashMap lookup.

repo: Cargo workspace lives at repo root with crates under `crates/`; desktop app at `apps/desktop/src-tauri/`
Desktop FUSE code was split into two layers: platform-agnostic data structures and platform-specific mount/unmount (macOS SMB, Linux FUSE, Windows WinFsp)
55 workspace tests: 12 crypto + 5 cross-language + 14 core + 24 desktop

Windows WinFsp operations were NOT extracted to `crates/fuse/src/platform/windows/` — the crate declares the module behind a feature flag but the directory is absent, creating a latent compilation bug
9 orphaned files (3,767 LOC) remained in `apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/fuse/` after extraction — never compiled but cluttering the repo
NETWORK_TIMEOUT has two intentionally different values: 10s for IPNS resolve, 3s for operations — pre-existing distinction, not a bug
`#[allow(unused_imports)]` re-exports in fuse crate are needed for Windows cross-compilation

code.finding: Double HashMap lookup — checked existence then fetched separately; fixed to single entry lookup
Had misleading `#[allow(dead_code)]` on the `implementation` module, which IS actively used by read_ops/write_ops/dir_ops within the crate

workflow: GSD wave-based parallel execution: Wave 3 agents hit usage limit mid-execution, leaving uncommitted partial work in crate directories. Re-spawning after resume picked up cleanly because no commits had been made yet.
Spot-checking after each wave (SUMMARY.md exists, git commits present, no Self-Check FAILED marker) correctly identified the usage-limit failure before proceeding
Pre-wave dependency key-link checks returned empty for waves 3 and 4 — no cross-plan wiring gaps detected
Parallel Wave 2 agents (23-02 and 23-03) had interleaved staging but no correctness impact
Code review agents flagged many pre-existing patterns that were merely moved, not introduced — important to triage moved code separately from new code

friction: Wave 3 agents hit the Claude usage limit mid-execution before committing any work, requiring a manual `resume` and full wave retry
Verification found 2 gaps after all 7 plans completed — Windows FUSE extraction was planned but not fully implemented (missing platform directory)
15K line diff across 94 files made code review agent output noisy with pre-existing patterns mixed in with new code
open_items: Windows WinFsp operations not extracted — `crates/fuse/src/platform/windows/` directory missing despite the crate declaring `pub mod windows` behind a feature flag; latent compilation bug on Windows targets
Gap closure cycle needed: `/gsd:plan-phase 23 --gaps` to address the 2 verification gaps before phase can be marked fully complete
Release Please configuration added for 5 Rust crates (23-07) but not yet exercised through an actual release
